$comment: Web Bot Auth verification (agentcake/detect/webbotauth.py): what a signature must carry, how far its times may be from this computer's clock, which keys are never trusted, what one verification may cost, and the text of each reason. Protocol: draft-ietf-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-01 over RFC 9421. Each setting is described in $doc.

$doc.tag: The tag parameter that marks a Web Bot Auth signature (draft -01 section 5.2). Signatures with another tag are not looked at.
$doc.algorithms: alg parameter values Agent Cake verifies. Only Ed25519 is implemented; another alg gives declared, unsupported-algorithm.
$doc.required_parameters: Signature parameters a Web Bot Auth signature must have (draft -01 section 5.2). Without one: declared, incomplete.
$doc.required_components_any: The signature must cover at least one of these (draft -01 section 5.2). Otherwise: declared, incomplete.
$doc.signature_agent_schemes: URL schemes accepted in Signature-Agent (draft -01 section 5.2.1 requires https).
$doc.directory_well_known_path: Path of a signer's key directory on its origin (draft -01 section 8.1). A Signature-Agent URL with this path, or none, names the host.
$doc.clock_skew_s: Seconds the signer's clock and this computer's may disagree, in both directions: a signature created up to this far in the future, or expired up to this long ago, still counts as inside its window. Outside it the result is declared, never invalid.
$doc.max_age_s: A signature older than this (from created) is declared, too-old, even when its expires is later. 86400 s follows draft -01 section 5.2 (expires no more than 24 hours after created).
$doc.max_signatures: At most this many Web Bot Auth signatures of one request are checked; each costs one Ed25519 verification.
$doc.rejected_key_thumbprints: Keys never trusted, by JWK thumbprint, with why. Published test keys must not be accepted in production (draft -01 section 6.8). A signature with one of them is declared, test-key.
$doc.verify_budget_ms: Most a single verification may take in pure Python (under 50 ms); tests measure the median of 100.
$doc.session_cache_size: Sessions whose verification result SessionVerifier keeps (least recently used are dropped first).
$doc.reasons: Text for each reason code; {signer}, {keyid}, {label}, {claimed} and the facts of the check are filled in. $missing stands in for a value that is not known.
$doc.details: The technical words of each reason code (what was checked), shown under its reason; the same facts fill them in.

reasons.verified-by-key: Verified: this request is signed with a key that {signer} publishes.
reasons.bad-signature: The signature check failed. Either the signed parts of the request changed, or the signature is forged.
reasons.unsupported-algorithm: The name is self-reported because this type of signature isn't checked.
reasons.unsupported-key: The name is self-reported because the signing key can't be checked.
reasons.incomplete: The name is self-reported because the signature is incomplete.
reasons.unknown-signer: The name is self-reported because this release doesn't include the signer's keys.
reasons.key-missing: The name is self-reported because this release doesn't include the signing key.
reasons.key-shared: The name is self-reported because more than one signer publishes the signing key.
reasons.test-key: The name is self-reported because the signing key isn't accepted.
reasons.key-not-yet-valid: The name is self-reported because the signing key wasn't valid yet when the request was signed.
reasons.key-expired: The name is self-reported because the signing key had expired when the request was signed.
reasons.not-yet-valid: The name is self-reported because the signature is dated in the future.
reasons.expired: The name is self-reported because the signature has expired.
reasons.too-old: The name is self-reported because the signature is older than the maximum age allowed.
reasons.no-signature-value: The name is self-reported because the signature value is missing.
reasons.unrebuildable: The name is self-reported because the signature can't be checked against this request.
reasons.claim-only: The name is self-reported because the request names a signer but doesn't include a signature.
reasons.unsigned: The request has no Web Bot Auth signature.

details.verified: The Web Bot Auth signature was verified with {signer}'s key {keyid}.
details.verified-by-key: The Web Bot Auth signature was verified with key {keyid}. The request doesn't include a signed Signature-Agent header with the signer's name.
details.bad-signature: The Web Bot Auth signature from {signer} didn't pass verification with key {keyid}.
details.unsupported-algorithm: The signature uses {alg}, which isn't verified here.
details.unsupported-key: Key {keyid} from {signer} isn't an Ed25519 key, which is the only type of key that's verified.
details.incomplete: The signature is missing {missing}, which Web Bot Auth requires.
details.unknown-signer: {signer} isn't one of the signers whose keys are included in this release.
details.key-missing: Key {keyid} isn't one of the {signer} keys included in this release. It might be a newer key.
details.key-not-yet-valid: Key {keyid} from {signer} becomes valid after the time the request was signed.
details.key-expired: Key {keyid} from {signer} expired before the request was signed.
details.not-yet-valid: The signature's timestamp is {seconds} seconds ahead of this server's clock.
details.too-old: The signature is {seconds} seconds old, and the maximum allowed age is {max_age_s} seconds.
details.no-signature-value: The Signature-Input header lists a signature named {label}, but the Signature header has no value for it.
details.unrebuildable: The content that {signer} signed can't be reconstructed from this request: {detail}.
details.claim-only: The Signature-Agent header names {claimed}, but the request doesn't include a Web Bot Auth signature.
